package main

func anotherProvisioner() {
 wireRoleCredential("target", "worker", "example-org/tracker", "x-access-token")
}

var anotherHelper = wireRoleCredential

// Only this receiver-free declaration is exempt, including aliases in its body.
func wireRoleTransport() {
 wireRoleCredential("target", "worker", "example-org/tracker", "x-access-token")
 helper := wireRoleCredential
 _ = helper
}

type valueProvisioner struct{}
func (valueProvisioner) wireRoleTransport() {
 wireRoleCredential("target", "worker", "example-org/tracker", "x-access-token")
 helper := wireRoleCredential
 _ = helper
}

type pointerProvisioner struct{}
func (*pointerProvisioner) wireRoleTransport() {
 wireRoleCredential("target", "worker", "example-org/tracker", "x-access-token")
 helper := wireRoleCredential
 _ = helper
}
